reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests the man to speak, which is a requested performed behavior and therefore governs action.
reasons.medium: No visual reference governs rendering; the sole audio reference supplies voice timbre only, so the rendering medium is request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference governs appearance and no wardrobe is specified, so wardrobe remains request-governed.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference governs lighting, and the audio sample does not authorize reference lighting, so lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference governs camera framing, so framing is request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference governs palette, so the scene's color and tonal treatment are request-governed.
